metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties (batch 1 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-IDLE is a quiescent state where no state modifications occur without JWT authentication
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the EL idle state handling in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify that the EL only transitions out of idle state via Engine API calls
3. Confirm all Engine API endpoints require JWT authentication before processing
4. Check that no background processes can modify state without going through authenticated channels
5. Verify there are no debug or admin endpoints that bypass JWT requirements
6. Confirm that the idle state has no scheduled state modifications
7. Test: Send unauthenticated request and verify it cannot trigger state changes

executable_checks.assertion: JWT handler wraps all Engine API endpoints
Engine API is registered with authentication

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-IDLE-001 -> Node STATE-EL-IDLE. This is the system's ground state. Security depends on JWT-HS256 authentication requirement for all state-modifying operations.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-CL-PREPARING-FORKCHOICE is exclusively reachable by trusted ACTOR-CL-CONSENSUS-CLIENT
detection_procedure: 1. Locate forkchoiceUpdated entry point in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace the call path from HTTP request to forkchoiceUpdated handler
3. Verify JWT authentication middleware is applied before handler execution
4. Confirm no alternative entry points exist for forkchoice updates
5. Check that the CL client must have the shared JWT secret
6. Verify websocket connections to Engine API also require JWT
7. Test: Attempt forkchoiceUpdated without valid JWT and verify rejection

executable_checks.assertion: Engine API methods in authenticated namespace

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-CL-PREPARING-FORKCHOICE-001 -> Node STATE-CL-PREPARING-FORKCHOICE. Trust assumption: CL client is correctly configured with shared JWT secret.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-CL-PREPARING-NEWPAYLOAD can only be reached by authenticated ACTOR-CL-CONSENSUS-CLIENT
detection_procedure: 1. Locate engine_newPayload entry point in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Trace call path from HTTP request to newPayload handler
3. Verify JWT middleware is applied to all newPayload versions (V1-V4)
4. Confirm payload submission requires valid JWT token
5. Check for any internal APIs that could submit payloads without auth
6. Verify error responses for unauthenticated newPayload requests
7. Test: Submit payload without JWT and verify rejection
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-CL-PREPARING-NEWPAYLOAD-001 -> Node STATE-CL-PREPARING-NEWPAYLOAD. While CL is trusted, payload content may originate from network and requires full validation.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT is a mandatory checkpoint for all Engine API requests
detection_procedure: 1. Locate JWT validation implementation in node/jwt_handler.go
2. Verify HS256 algorithm is enforced (reject other algorithms)
3. Check signature verification against shared secret from jwt.hex
4. Verify 'iat' (issued at) claim validation within +/-60 second window
5. Confirm algorithm confusion attacks are prevented (reject 'none' algorithm)
6. Check for constant-time signature comparison
7. Verify JWT middleware is applied before any request parsing
8. Check error handling doesn't leak timing information
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-JWT. Critical security control point. Implementation must reject expired tokens and validate signature correctly.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED is a terminal state with no paths to processing states
detection_procedure: 1. Locate JWT rejection handling in node/jwt_handler.go
2. Verify rejected requests receive HTTP 401/403 response
3. Confirm no further processing occurs after rejection
4. Check that rejection is logged for audit purposes
5. Verify error response does not leak sensitive information
6. Check for timing side-channels in rejection path
7. Confirm connection is not kept alive for rejected requests

executable_checks.assertion: Proper HTTP error codes for rejection

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED-001 -> Node STATE-EL-JWT-REJECTED. Proper error response should be returned without leaking timing information.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-PROCESS-FORKCHOICE is only reachable via successful JWT validation
detection_procedure: 1. In eth/catalyst/api.go, locate ForkchoiceUpdatedV1/V2/V3 handlers
2. Trace the HTTP handler chain to verify JWT middleware is applied
3. Confirm ForkchoiceUpdated is registered under authenticated Engine API
4. Verify no direct invocation paths bypass HTTP layer
5. Check for any test/debug modes that skip authentication
6. Verify internal RPC calls also require authentication
7. Test: Call forkchoiceUpdated without JWT and verify 401 response
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-PROCESS-FORKCHOICE-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-PROCESS-FORKCHOICE. Source file: eth/catalyst/api.go:162-183.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS prevents setting head to non-existent blocks
detection_procedure: 1. In eth/catalyst/api.go, find block lookup logic in forkchoiceUpdated
2. Verify GetBlockByHash or similar is called for headBlockHash
3. Confirm missing block triggers SYNCING status response
4. Check safe and finalized block hashes are also validated
5. Verify no race conditions between lookup and usage
6. Confirm database lookup is against canonical chain
7. Test: Send forkchoiceUpdated with non-existent hash and verify SYNCING response
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-CHECK-BLOCK-EXISTS. This is a database lookup operation. Integrity depends on local chain database.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-SYNCING correctly reports missing head block to CL
detection_procedure: 1. Locate SYNCING status construction in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify PayloadStatusV1 is returned with status='SYNCING'
3. Confirm latestValidHash is set correctly for sync recovery
4. Check that SYNCING response triggers P2P sync in CL
5. Verify no state modifications occur in SYNCING path
6. Confirm SYNCING is distinguishable from INVALID status
7. Test: Verify correct SYNCING response format

executable_checks.assertion: Latest valid hash tracking for sync

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-SYNCING-001 -> Node STATE-EL-SYNCING. SYNCING response allows CL to request missing blocks via P2P sync.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD only accepts verified, locally-stored blocks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate SetHead or similar in core/blockchain.go
2. Verify block must exist in local storage before setting as head
3. Confirm block must have valid parent chain to genesis
4. Check for proper reorg handling when head changes
5. Verify atomic head update (no partial state)
6. Confirm chain reorganization events are emitted
7. Test: Attempt to set head to unvalidated block hash
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-SET-CANONICAL-HEAD. Chain reorganization security depends on this check.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE maintains consistency with canonical head
detection_procedure: 1. Locate finalized/safe block updates in eth/catalyst/api.go or core/blockchain.go
2. Verify finalized block is ancestor of canonical head
3. Confirm safe block is between finalized and head
4. Check finalized block cannot be changed once set (monotonic)
5. Verify update only occurs after successful head setting
6. Confirm reorg beyond finalized block is rejected
7. Test: Attempt to set finalized block not in canonical chain
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-UPDATE-FINALIZED-SAFE. Finalized blocks cannot be reverted. Safe blocks have high confidence of finality.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-START-PAYLOAD-BUILD only triggers with valid PayloadAttributes from authenticated CL
detection_procedure: 1. In eth/catalyst/api.go, find payload building trigger in forkchoiceUpdated
2. Verify PayloadAttributes presence check before building
3. Confirm building only starts after successful forkchoice processing
4. Check PayloadAttributes validation (timestamp, feeRecipient)
5. Verify PayloadID is generated and returned to CL
6. Confirm building uses authenticated request context
7. Test: Attempt to trigger building without PayloadAttributes
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-START-PAYLOAD-BUILD-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-START-PAYLOAD-BUILD. The ACTOR-MINER-BUILDER is an internal trusted component.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING only uses validated transactions from pending pool
detection_procedure: 1. Locate payload building in miner/worker.go or miner/payload_building.go
2. Verify transactions are sourced from txpool.Pending()
3. Confirm no direct transaction injection bypassing pool
4. Check transaction ordering respects gas price priority
5. Verify gas limit is respected during transaction selection
6. Confirm EIP-4844 blob gas limits are enforced
7. Test: Verify built payload contains only pool transactions
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING-001 -> Node STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-BUILDING. Block builder uses validated transactions only. Transaction signature verification (secp256k1) is prerequisite.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-FORKCHOICE-RESPONSE-READY returns accurate payload status
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ForkchoiceUpdated response construction in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify PayloadStatus reflects true validation state
3. Confirm PayloadID is returned when building was started
4. Check latestValidHash is set correctly
5. Verify response structure matches Engine API spec
6. Confirm no response forgery is possible
7. Test: Verify response matches internal state
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-FORKCHOICE-RESPONSE-READY-001 -> Node STATE-EL-FORKCHOICE-RESPONSE-READY. Response integrity is critical for consensus safety.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-PROCESS-NEWPAYLOAD is only reachable via successful JWT validation
detection_procedure: 1. In eth/catalyst/api.go, locate NewPayloadV1/V2/V3/V4 handlers
2. Trace HTTP handler chain to verify JWT middleware
3. Confirm NewPayload is registered under authenticated Engine API
4. Verify no direct invocation paths bypass HTTP layer
5. Check for test/debug modes that skip authentication
6. Confirm internal RPC calls require authentication
7. Test: Call newPayload without JWT and verify 401 response
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-PROCESS-NEWPAYLOAD-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-PROCESS-NEWPAYLOAD. Source file: eth/catalyst/api.go. JWT-HS256 authentication required.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-PAYLOAD-STRUCTURE rejects malformed payloads before processing
detection_procedure: 1. In eth/catalyst/api.go, find payload structure validation
2. Verify parent hash references existing block
3. Confirm timestamp > parent timestamp
4. Check block hash matches computed hash from fields
5. Verify transaction root matches Merkle root
6. Confirm version-specific fields are validated (Shanghai withdrawals, Cancun blobs)
7. Verify INVALID_BLOCK_HASH is returned for hash mismatch
8. Test: Submit payload with incorrect block hash
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-PAYLOAD-STRUCTURE-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-VALIDATE-PAYLOAD-STRUCTURE. Validates: parent exists, timestamp ordering, block hash matches computed hash.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-INVALID-STRUCTURE terminates processing without state modification
detection_procedure: 1. Locate invalid structure handling in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify INVALID status is returned immediately
3. Confirm no block insertion or state modification occurs
4. Check error response includes appropriate error details
5. Verify latestValidHash is set for chain recovery
6. Confirm no side effects from invalid payload processing
7. Test: Submit structurally invalid payload and verify clean rejection
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-INVALID-STRUCTURE-001 -> Node STATE-EL-PAYLOAD-INVALID-STRUCTURE. INVALID_BLOCK_HASH status returned to CL. No state modifications for invalid payloads.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-CONVERT-PAYLOAD-TO-BLOCK preserves data integrity during conversion
detection_procedure: 1. Locate ExecutableDataToBlock in beacon/engine/types.go
2. Verify all ExecutableData fields map correctly to Block
3. Confirm block hash is recomputed after conversion
4. Check converted hash matches declared hash
5. Verify transaction unmarshaling preserves signatures
6. Confirm withdrawals are correctly converted (Shanghai+)
7. Test: Convert payload and verify hash integrity
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-CONVERT-PAYLOAD-TO-BLOCK-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-CONVERT-PAYLOAD-TO-BLOCK. Block hash computed from converted data must match payload's declared hash.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-INSERT-BLOCK-WITHOUT-HEAD stores blocks without updating canonical head
detection_procedure: 1. Locate InsertBlockWithoutSetHead in core/blockchain.go
2. Verify function stores block but does not call SetHead
3. Confirm block is accessible for later validation
4. Check canonical head remains unchanged after insertion
5. Verify block can be retrieved by hash for processing
6. Confirm this path is used by Engine API newPayload
7. Test: Insert block and verify head is unchanged
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-INSERT-BLOCK-WITHOUT-HEAD-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-INSERT-BLOCK-WITHOUT-HEAD. Source: core/blockchain.go. Non-canonical insertion prevents premature chain reorganization.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK executes all transactions and validates state root
detection_procedure: 1. Locate state processor in core/state_processor.go
2. Verify Process function executes all transactions in order
3. Confirm state root is computed after all executions
4. Check computed state root is compared against header
5. Verify receipts root is also validated
6. Confirm any failure leads to INVALID status
7. Check gas used matches header gas used
8. Test: Process block with mismatched state root
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK-001 -> Node ACTION-EL-PROCESS-BLOCK. Source: core/state_processor.go:60-139. Delegates to GRAPH-BLOCK-PROCESSING sub-graph.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID is only reached when all validations pass including state root
detection_procedure: 1. Trace paths to VALID status in eth/catalyst/api.go
2. Verify state root comparison occurs before VALID
3. Confirm all transactions executed successfully
4. Check receipts root matches header
5. Verify gas used matches header
6. Confirm no VALID status for partial validation
7. Check logs hash matches header (for old blocks)
8. Test: Verify VALID only after full validation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID-001 -> Node STATE-EL-BLOCK-VALID. State root is the cryptographic commitment to all account balances, storage, and code. Merkle Patricia Trie verification.
